blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) fell short of its revenue target for the first nine months of the year by P43 billion, though it still posted double-digit growth in September. As of Oct. 13, the latest data showed that the BIR collected P203.58 billion in September, an 11-percent jump from the P183.5 billion collected in the same month last year, which the agency attributed to voluntary tax compliance and proactive taxpayer assistance initiatives.
